subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro + calendar options
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Carter <emily.carter@clearwaterhealth.com>, Rajat Singh <rajat.singh@clearwaterhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro + calendar options

Hi Emily and Rajat —

Great to speak earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before the demo: 

- Primary use case: in-product summarization for clinician notes and shorter discharge summaries; throughput expectation ~150k tokens/day with peak spikes during morning huddles.
- Non-negotiables: on-prem/private deployment (PHI), SOC 2 evidence, and ability to pin model versions during validation.
- Key stakeholders: Rajat (CTO) on architecture/security; Emily (PM) on UX/flows; you mentioned adding a security lead for the technical deep dive.

Next step: 30-minute intro demo focused on how Redwood would integrate with your pipeline (VPC option, latency profiles, and a short look at cost controls). I’ve attached a one-pager agenda and a starter mutual action plan for procurement.

Proposed 30-min windows (pick one or propose alternatives):
1) Thu Apr 22, 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Thu Apr 22, 15:00–15:30 PT
3) Fri Apr 23, 09:00–09:30 PT

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: quick intros & success criteria
- 15m: product demo focused on integration points and security controls
- 5m: deployment/ops & cost levers (batching, quantization options)
- 5m: next steps / mutual action plan items

Please confirm which slot works and who else from your side should join (security/infra). If none of these work, share two alternative times and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: redwood-30m-demo-agenda.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
